subtitle: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about GeoAnalyzer

general.q: How is GeoAnalyzer different from the competition?
general.a: We are one of a kind. Competitors show 'where', but we answer the question 'what is it like to live there?'. We don't just display objects; we aggregate them into safety, comfort, and investment attractiveness rankings, saving you dozens of hours of independent research.

general.q: What area does the service cover?
general.a: We currently operate in the Polish market and are constantly adding new locations. If you haven't found a city you need, it means it is in the queue for processing. Our goal is to cover as many locations as possible so that everyone can find exactly what they are looking for.

general.q: Can the service be used on mobile devices?
general.a: Yes, our interface is fully responsive. You can explore districts on your laptop at home or on your smartphone while on the go.

subscription.q: Who is the 'Weekly' plan suitable for?
subscription.a: This is an ideal offer for those in the active phase of searching for a home. You get full Premium functionality for a symbolic fee for 7 days, which is usually enough to choose an apartment.
Yes, of course. You can disable auto-renewal at any time in your profile settings. Access to paid features will remain active until the end of the currently paid period.

subscription.q: What are White Label reports in the Realtor Pro plan?
subscription.a: This feature allows real estate agents to generate PDF district reports without the GeoAnalyzer logo. You can add your own contact details and branding, providing clients with professional analytics under your own name or brand.

data.a: We use cross-verification of data from several authoritative sources. However, a city is a living organism, and changes happen daily. We strive to update our database as promptly as possible.

data.q: Where does the safety information come from?
data.a: The safety index is generated based on official crime statistics, street lighting data, the presence of surveillance cameras, and proximity to police stations.

data.q: How often is the database updated?
data.a: Real estate prices and ecological indicators are updated in near real-time. Infrastructural changes are made according to the update schedule of primary registers.

account.q: How can I contact technical support?
account.a: For quick assistance, use the contact form on the website in the 'Contact' section or email us at youworkday@gmail.com. We respond within 24 hours.
We do not store your card details. All payments are processed by the international provider Stripe, which holds the highest level of PCI DSS security certification.
